original_value: The latest Nearline models by Toshiba are part of their mid-end enterprise class line so naturally these models come with extra features such as 24/7 operation, standard ECC (Error Correction Code), MTBF (Meantime Between Failures) of 1.2 million hours and finally their Secure Cryptographic Erase SED Function. Equipped with SATA 6.0 Gbit/s interface, the Enterprise Capacity, these models help to save rack space and reduce the footprint and operational burden of business critical servers and storage systems.

result.paraphrase: Toshiba’s latest Nearline models belong to its mid-range enterprise lineup and therefore include added features such as 24/7 operation, standard ECC (Error Correction Code), 1.2 million hours MTBF (Meantime Between Failures), and a Secure Cryptographic Erase SED function. With a SATA 6.0 Gbit/s interface and enterprise capacity, these models help save rack space while reducing the footprint and operational burden of business-critical servers and storage systems.
